questions.question: Which frontier does BFS use?
questions.explanation: FIFO processing explores one distance layer before the next.

questions.question: Why keep a visited set?
options: To prevent repeated processing and cycles
questions.explanation: Graphs may contain several paths to the same vertex and cycles.

questions.question: Adjacency-list BFS/DFS time is…
questions.explanation: Each vertex and edge is processed a constant number of times.

questions.question: Which finds shortest path by edge count in an unweighted graph?
questions.explanation: BFS discovers vertices in nondecreasing distance from the start.
